server.name: travel-agent-demo
server.title: Wayfinder · Travel lab
server.description: Explore travel intent, fare rules and a complete sandbox refund workflow.

protocolMetadata.instructions: This is a sandbox travel demo, never a live airline service. Start with get-travel-guidance, clarify whether the traveller needs refunds or changes, then search-travel. Missing conditions are unknown. Fare names are not evidence of refundability. Use rank-travel-offers to compare the same offers with/without guidance. Create test bookings only after user confirmation. Before confirm-refund, show the current quote amount, currency and destination and obtain explicit confirmation. Do not claim a traveller has received money. Skills over MCP are available to supporting hosts; get-travel-guidance works for all clients.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wayfinder · Travel lab to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wayfinder · Travel lab to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://wild-cloud-p762x.run.mcp-use.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Wayfinder · Travel lab MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Wayfinder · Travel lab scores 87/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Wayfinder · Travel lab's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Wayfinder · Travel lab scores 49/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 7 of 7 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.
